-- edge flicks: from just inside each crown outward, following its contour
local fb = brush{kind="filbert", width=4, stiffness=0.45}
local count = 0
for _, o in ipairs({E2, L2, R2}) do
  local L = o:length()
  local t = 0
  while t < 1 do
    local p = o:at(t)
    local q = o:at(math.min(1, t + 0.003))
    local tx, ty = q[1]-p[1], q[2]-p[2]
    local len = math.sqrt(tx*tx+ty*ty) + 1e-6
    -- outward normal: try both and pick the one outside the mask
    local nx, ny = -ty/len, tx/len
    if keep:at(p[1]+nx*6, p[2]+ny*6) > 0.5 then nx, ny = -nx, -ny end
    if p[2] < 384 and p[1] < 1005 then
      fb:load(folD, 0.35)
      local a = math.atan(ny, nx) + rand(-0.6, 0.6)
      local l = rand(6, 14)
      local sx, sy = p[1] - nx*5, p[2] - ny*5
      fb:stroke({{sx, sy}, {sx + math.cos(a)*l, sy + math.sin(a)*l}}, {pressure={0.5, 0.05}, ramps={0.1, 0.7}})
      count = count + 1
    end
    t = t + rand(5, 12) / L
  end
end
print(count)
